name: Minecraft Paper
author: GrassNotFound
description: High-performance Minecraft Java server based on Paper.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ -z "${PAPER_VERSION}" ] || [ "${PAPER_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then PAPER_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper | jq -r '.versions[-1]'); fi
if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ]; then BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${PAPER_VERSION} | jq -r '.builds[-1]'); else BUILD_NUMBER=${BUILD_NUMBER}; fi
curl -fLo ${SERVER_JARFILE} https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${PAPER_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/paper-${PAPER_VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}.jar
echo 'Install Complete'
